name: rihla-plugin
description: Create branded CX cards, analyze feedback, and design survey and journey drafts in Rihla.

interface.shortDescription: Customer experience analysis and design with Rihla.
interface.longDescription: Five Arabic and English CX skills with an OAuth connection to Rihla production. Visual cards use your organization’s branding and the host’s rendering tools.
defaultPrompt: Create a CX card using my logo and brand colors.
Analyze customer feedback and suggest improvements.
Create a short visitor satisfaction survey draft.
